details: Package @zannstore/baileys@2.3.9 was scanned across 433 files with no a static rule matches and no traced installer-harm behavior surfaced. The package name suggests a fork or republication of the Baileys WhatsApp library family, which has historically contained forks with covert side-effects (e.g. auto-follow/subscribe using the installer's session), but no such behavior was concretely observed in this artifact. No credential reads, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no install/import-time fetch-and-execute, and no lifecycle-script droppers were identified.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
